obernants.operator: Universe U consists of the seven tagged supplied-input fixtures and candidate observations at their declared APIs. R requires local Lex class/frame (1,1,0), ordered Agent/Theme/Recipient roles and score 8; active/passive subject roles Agent/Theme and scores 4/8; sentence-1 Bob copied at frame 3; survivor frame map 0->0,3->1 with unchanged predicate token pairs; only sentence-0 participle added; only oblique slot 5 resolved; and accepted/proposed role transfers with exact Frame JSON preservation. U minus R excludes swapped lexical roles, global-Lex index substitution, Alice copied across sentences, dangling deleted frame indices, altered token coordinates, adding the wrong sentence token, changing recipient while resolving an oblique, rejected/off rule execution and changed non-target Frame fields. This is a source-derived assertion relation, not a proven complement for all Rust paths; malformed domains and unexecuted branches remain unknown.

obernants.operator: For each tagged output y retain all supplied antecedents x satisfying its stated relation and shared coordinates. Match indices require the exact retained local Lex; roles/scores do not recover XML formatting, unused classes, examples, filler identity or animacy. Head copying and kind changes lose overwritten values. Deletion loses removed frames and incoming references while retaining survivor predicate coordinates. Added participle frames do not recover a complete tree; pronoun resolution leaves multiple compatible prior discourse lists. Full Frame JSON recovers that Frame on the lawful serialization domain, not the originating tree. Patient/recipient transfer is uniquely reversible only with occupied source, empty destination and all other state retained. Parent reverse composition existentially retains shared intermediate Lex/Read snapshots, never arbitrary independently chosen coordinates.
